extract: The Rainbow Landscape is a 1632–1635 oil painting by Peter Paul Rubens, one of a number of autograph works on the subject. Originally owned by Prince Richelieu, it was later given to Count Brühl by the Bavarian elector, son of Charles VII, Holy Roman Emperor.
